A LITTLE ABOUT THIS PASSION

Ever since I was a child, I’ve been in love with films. For me, cinema is therapy for the soul — a place to feel, reflect and see life through another perspective. This journal brings together the films that stayed with me and the stories I’m discovering along the way.
